npcs.name: Osmois Tearlock
npcs.description: Pale-purple tiefling registration official with a single horn and octagonal spectacles. Registered the Green Iguanas at Dragonbowl.

npcs.name: Obi Dew Diva
npcs.description: Flamboyant djinni announcer and master of ceremonies for Dragonbowl.

npcs.name: Gnashhu / King Cackle
npcs.description: One-eyed gnoll leader of the Cackle Crew. Freed severed his arm during the Green Iguanas’ Round One victory; his ultimate fate has not been separately confirmed.

npcs.name: The freed wizard
npcs.description: An unnamed captive forced to manufacture the red dragon’s counterfeit treasure. The Green Iguanas freed him; his former party’s paid entry helped them reach Dragonbowl.

quests.title: The Dragonbowl Championship
quests.summary: The Green Iguanas won their opening bout against Cackle Crew. Their known next opponent is the Dandy War Dolls in the quarterfinals; further results depend on play.

dragonbowlMatches.title: Round One · Green Iguanas vs Cackle Crew
dragonbowlMatches.summary: RESULT: Green Iguanas victory. Highlights: Freed severed King Cackle’s arm, Bobby Kills struck a gnoll with his axe, Owen fought as a tiger within Globe of Twilight, and Indigo energized the crowd.

achievements.title: Arena Breakthrough
achievements.description: Party milestone: defeated Cackle Crew in the first Dragonbowl bout. Confirmed from actual play; session date not supplied.
